name: Battery Status
plain: Battery level, charging state and time estimates, without a prompt on Chromium.
meaning: Shows how drained a phone or laptop is. Researchers showed level plus charge time works as a short-term tracking ID. Site could raise prices for low battery or tell laptop from desktop.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

limits.headline: Can see your battery level and charging state, with no prompt in Chrome
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page runs the check
can: Check how full your battery is and whether it is charging
See estimated minutes to full or empty
Tell a laptop or phone from a desktop that has no battery
Use level plus charge time as a short term tracking clue
cannot: Work in Safari or on iPhone
Work in Firefox, which removed it
See battery health, make, or exact power draw
Track you for long; the level changes within minutes
limits.reach_label: Current battery, while the page is open
limits.differs: Chrome, Edge, and Samsung Internet allow it. Firefox removed it and Safari never offered it.

story.what_it_is: Battery level, charging state and time left, readable by a page without a pop-up in Chromium browsers.

marketing.name: Battery Status API
marketing.pitch: Developer docs describe it as a way for pages to adapt behaviour to the device power state.

story.for_you: You do not get asked, and you will not notice it happening. A site may quietly decide to show a lighter page if your phone is almost empty. Or it may record your battery number as a clue about you.
story.for_makers: Developers use it to be kind to batteries and to warn people before a long task. Ad and fraud teams watch it as one more detail that is hard for a bot or a fake device to get right. Privacy teams treat the combined level and timing as a risk.

use_cases.example: A cloud gaming page warns you to plug in your laptop because streaming at high quality drains the battery fast.
A video call app suggests turning off the camera when the battery is at 5 percent.
A web workout player lowers screen effects so a phone survives the full class.
An online exam site checks that the laptop is plugged in before a timed test begins.
A bank's fraud tool sees a device claiming to be a phone with a battery that never changes and flags it as an emulator.
A booking site shows a lighter mobile page when a traveller's battery is low in an airport.

risks: Combines with other clues to follow you

technical_bounds: Desktop without a battery reports charging true, level 1
Cannot read battery health or temperature

legit_uses: Low-power mode for video or sync

linkedin.how: Battery level, charging state, discharge estimate (BleepingComputer: battery status). Read by the LinkedIn APFC fingerprint script (48 features, alleged by BrowserGate, partly confirmed by BleepingComputer).

history.change: Olejnik et al. show battery data can track users across sites
Permissions-Policy battery integration discussed; Safari and Firefox refuse to ship

refs.label: Olejnik et al. The leaking battery (2015)
